task_summary: Compose a low-poly floating-island scene with a main island, waterfall, and 3 satellite islands, readable as a game environment establishing shot, stylized pastel palette.
custom_weights_rationale: Readability-first scene brief: composition leads (.25), structure follows (.20). reference_similarity removed (original scene, no canonical target) and its weight redistributed.

problems.issue: Rightmost background satellite competes with the focal island (same value family, ~55% of hero size)
problems.evidence: OBSERVED: at 25% shrink the eye flickers between the right satellite and the main island
problems.likely_cause: satellites authored at the hero's value/saturation without depth falloff
problems.recommended_fix: Grade the satellite ~15-20% toward sky value or shrink it to <=40% of the main island

problems.issue: Six foreground grass tufts share one identical rotation
problems.evidence: OBSERVED: identical lean angle across the tuft row at the lower frame edge
problems.likely_cause: single tuft instance cloned along the edge
problems.recommended_fix: Jitter tuft yaw +/-15-25deg and vary scale 0.8-1.3x
